title: Edge count of a finite tree
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph that is a tree, meaning it is connected and contains no cycles. Then the number of edges of $G$ is one less than the number of vertices; that is, if $G$ has $n$ vertices, then it has exactly $n - 1$ edges.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
G is a tree (connected and acyclic)
